ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/cream) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity (black) pixels at the base and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are mapped to the peduncle insertion point and the extreme trailing edge. A dark circular ring-like spot is visible in the upper mid-section of the left lobe, and a small dark focal spot is visible in the mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the lobe horizon.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by jagged pixel peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges leading toward the notch; convex leading edges tapering to acute tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of rough, multi-toned (white, grey, black) pixel groups representing barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, horizontal dark linear disruption visible in the lower interior quadrant of the left lobe; minor vertical dark markings near the peduncle interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations at lobe tips; distinct dark circular 'donut' scar on the upper-left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent dark ring-shaped pigmentation feature located on the mid-upper left lobe.
